13-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (92-bet).

Yuqorida chapda 'UNIT 13'. O'ngda katta sariq qiya 'Join in the Fun!'. SURATLAR: A - Yaponiya festivali, bayroqli ko'k kiyimli odamlar yurishi (kite festival, Hamamatsu); B - an'anaviy kashtali kostyumli, boshiga qizil sharf o'ragan odamlar karnay chalmoqda; C - kechasi shahar markazida yorug' bezakli aravalar (floats) va olomon; (D - 93-betda: katta rangli varrak).

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Lead-in'.
1) 'Look at the pictures and tick the correct boxes.' 1 Which country are the pictures from? Japan ☐ England ☐. 2 What do they show? a food festival ☐ a kite festival ☐. 3 What are the people in picture B wearing? suits ☐; embroidered costumes ☐; gloves ☐; scarves ☐? 4 Which picture shows: (A B C D kataklar) people banging drums; a colourful kite; brightly-coloured floats; people waving flags?
2) 'Do people fly kites in your country? If so, when, and for what reason?'
3) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and underline the correct answer.' 1 Every year, between 3rd and 5th MARCH/MAY, the local people fly colourful kites. 2 It all started about 430/340 years ago. 3 Everywhere I went I could SMELL/TRY cakes and sweets cooking. 4 I noticed that every GROUP/TEAM had different costumes. 5 They wore STRINGS/SCARVES around their heads. 6 The atmosphere was TERRIBLE/FANTASTIC. 7 It made me feel SAD/HAPPY to think that I would leave for Tokyo the next day.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '92'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and tick the correct boxes.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang va to'g'ri kataklarni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATLAR:
  A - bayroq silkitayotgan odamlar
      (Yaponiya)
  B - kashtali kostyum va sharfli
      odamlar karnay chalmoqda
  C - kechasi yorug' aravalar
      (floats)
  D (93-bet) - katta rangli varrak


JAVOBLAR:
  1 Japan
  2 a kite festival
  3 embroidered costumes; scarves
  4 people banging drums - B;
    a colourful kite - D;
    brightly-coloured floats - C;
    people waving flags - A


⚠ 'A KITE':

  = varrak.
  ⚠ 'to fly a kite' = varrak
  uchirmoq.


⚠ 'EMBROIDERED':

  = kashtali.
  ⚠ 'embroidery' = kashta.


⚠ 'A COSTUME':

  = kostyum (milliy/festival kiyimi).
  ⚠ 'suit' = kostyum (rasmiy).


⚠ 'A SCARF / SCARVES':

  = sharf, ro'mol.
  ⚠ Ko'plik 'scarves' - 'f' → 'v'.


⚠ 'TO BANG DRUMS':

  = nog'ora urmoq.


⚠ 'A FLOAT':

  = bezatilgan arava (festival).


⚠ 'TO WAVE FLAGS':

  = bayroq silkitmoq.

items.en: Do people fly kites in your country? If so, when, and for what reason?
items.uz: Sizning mamlakatingizda odamlar varrak uchiradimi? Agar shunday bo'lsa, qachon va nima sababdan?
items.answerEn: Yes, they do. Children usually fly kites in spring and summer, when it's windy. They do it for fun.
items.answerUz: Ha. Bolalar odatda bahor va yozda, shamolli kunlarda varrak uchiradi. Ular buni o'yin-kulgi uchun qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and underline the correct answer.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va to'g'ri javob tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio yo'q bo'lsa - 93-betdagi
'The Kite Battles' matnidan
tekshiring.


JAVOBLAR (matn bo'yicha):
  1 May  2 430  3 smell  4 team
  5 scarves  6 fantastic  7 sad


⚠ 'LOCAL PEOPLE':

  = mahalliy odamlar.


⚠ 'THE ATMOSPHERE':

  = muhit, kayfiyat.


⚠ 'TO LEAVE FOR':

  = ...ga jo'nab ketmoq.
  ⚠ 'leave Tokyo' = Tokiodan
  ketmoq; 'leave FOR Tokyo' =
  Tokioga jo'namoq!

items.textEn: 1 Every year, between 3rd and 5th March/May, the local people fly colourful kites.
items.uz: 1 Har yili 3-5 may oralig'ida mahalliy odamlar rangli varraklar uchiradi.

items.textEn: 2 It all started about 430/340 years ago.
3 Everywhere I went I could smell/try cakes and sweets cooking.
items.uz: 3 Qayerga bormay, pishirilayotgan tort va shirinliklar hidini sezardim.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Matn: 'I could smell cakes and sweets cooking'.

items.textEn: 4 I noticed that every group/team had different costumes.
items.uz: 4 Har bir jamoa turli kostyumda ekanini payqadim.

items.textEn: 5 They wore strings/scarves around their heads.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Matn: 'They wore scarves around their heads'.

items.textEn: 7 It made me feel sad/happy to think that I would leave for Tokyo the next day.
items.uz: 7 Ertasi kuni Tokioga jo'nab ketishimni o'ylash meni xafa qildi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Matn: 'It made me feel sad to think ...'.
